description.fun: Munna drifts to people's pillows late at night and eats their dreams, and the sleeper forgets what the dream was about. A good dream makes it breathe out pink mist and its flower patterns glow with happiness, while a nightmare turns the mist black, so it eats bad dreams to cure them. Designed by Atsuko Nishida, it seems to draw on the dream-eating baku of legend and on Japanese pig-shaped incense burners.
description.guide: Munna is a Psychic-type Pokémon that floats in the air and eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. It releases pink mist after a good dream and black mist after a nightmare. It evolves into Musharna with a Moon Stone.
description.tagline: A floating pink dream-eater that gobbles your nightmares.

description.fun: Musharna is always dozing, even with its eyes open, and the mist rising from its forehead takes the shapes of the dreams it has eaten. Keep away when that mist turns dark: it can make your nightmares come true. It's a terrible grump when freshly woken. It was designed before the Dream World existed, then tied to it because the two fit so well, and the Dream Ball borrows its look.
description.guide: Musharna is the evolved form of Munna, a Psychic-type Pokémon based on the dream-eating baku. The Dream Mist that seeps from its forehead takes the shapes of dreams it has eaten, and it sleeps almost constantly.
description.tagline: A sleepy dream tapir whose forehead mist takes the shape of dreams.
